table_cell_dispositions.raw_cell_en: Case mutations, approval decisions and outbox inserts commit in one ACID transaction. Search indexing and external webhooks are asynchronous and reconciled.

section_en: 2. API Specification / Processing and Consistency / Transaction and Replay Requirements

table_cell_dispositions.raw_cell_en: Final response pointer and satisfied publication gate are recorded in the same transaction. Recompute evidence authorization at publication; an old approval never authorizes a different artifact.

section_en: 2. API Specification / Processing and Consistency / Transaction and Replay Requirements

table_cell_dispositions.raw_cell_en: Long-running POST creation requires `Idempotency-Key`. Identical replay returns original operation; changed fingerprint with same key returns `IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT`. Case idempotency binds actor/request fingerprint to one outcome for 24 hours.
API-001, 006, 008–009, 018, 023, 025–026; other job-creating POSTs once classified

section_en: 2. API Specification / Processing and Consistency / Transaction and Replay Requirements

table_cell_dispositions.raw_cell_en: Every cross-service write is retry-idempotent. At-least-once consumers deduplicate event IDs/operation keys and reject stale aggregate revisions; queue ordering across partitions is not an invariant.

section_en: 2. API Specification / Processing and Consistency / Transaction and Replay Requirements

table_cell_dispositions.raw_cell_en: Stale/unauthorized writes leave business state unchanged. Rejected attempts may retain safe audit evidence but must not publish an accepted-transition event.

section_en: 2. API Specification / Processing and Consistency / Transaction and Replay Requirements

table_cell_dispositions.raw_cell_en: Every tenant-owned access uses tenant context/RLS. Reset connection-pool scoped session variables after every transaction; enforce workspace-tenancy membership.

section_en: 2. API Specification / Processing and Consistency / Transaction and Replay Requirements

table_cell_dispositions.raw_cell_en: Soft-deleted entities cannot be retrieved. Blob references are opaque, encrypted and accessed through short-lived authorization-controlled signed URLs.

section_en: 2. API Specification / Processing and Consistency / Transaction and Replay Requirements

table_cell_dispositions.raw_cell_en: Cache keys include tenant, user-scope digest, source ACL revision, query hash and index generation. Authorization changes invalidate affected entries before ordinary TTL expiry and before next retrieval.

Persist cursor/high-watermark/error ledger; cursor advances only after all preceding outcomes are durable, including recorded quarantine exception. Partial batches retry safely
Retry cap/classification, per-item commit unit, partial-success enum, cursor expiration and concurrent cursor ownership

Trust-mode enum, blocked capabilities, remediation controls and HTTP/code

Persist plan revision before effects and stage checkpoints before dispatch; no partial-as-approved output

Depth maximum eight; tool invocations maximum sixteen. Reads may retry transient faults; consequential mutations require idempotency/human authorization. Stop codes, timeout recovery and A2A decline handling Need confirmation

Invalidate affected caches before ordinary TTL/new results. For suspected leak, suspend affected aliases and revoke cached evidence while preserving audit
